journey.name: Sign in and see the cameras
journey.description: A first sign-in to the household Frigate server. The server is the fake Frigate (./gradlew :fake-frigate:run) on the host machine, which the emulator reaches at 10.0.2.2.

actions.action: Verify that the sign-in screen is shown, with the title "PERCYSAFE" and a "Connect" button
Clear the server URL field (it starts filled in) and type http://10.0.2.2:8971
Tap the "Username" field and type admin
Tap the "Password" field and type correct-horse
Verify that the home screen is shown, with a "Tailscale" badge at the top right and "Home" selected in the bottom navigation
Verify that there are camera cards named "Front Door", "Driveway" and "Back Yard" (scroll down if needed)
